title: Design Enterprise CI/CD Pipelines
description: Design pipelines for monorepos, microservices, and compliance requirements.

data.text: Your org has 12 services, shared libraries, and infrastructure code. Design a CI/CD strategy that balances speed, safety, and compliance.

data.title: GitHub Actions Monorepo Pipeline
data.code:
name: CI/CD
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'
      - run: dotnet build --configuration Release

  test:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        service: [orders, inventory, billing]
    steps:
      - run: dotnet test ./src/${{ matrix.service }}/${{ matrix.service }}.csproj
